CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, gender TEXT, phone TEXT, email TEXT, medical_notes TEXT, emergency_contacts TEXT, created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS routes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, start_time TEXT, session_id TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'active')
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, route_id INTEGER, latitude REAL, longitude REAL, timestamp TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tracking_sessions (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, phone TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, route_id INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, started_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, ended_ms INTEGER, next_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_sample_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_running_tracking_session ON tracking_sessions ((1)) WHERE state IN ('STARTING','ACTIVE','INTERRUPTED')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tracking_outbox (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, operation_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, group_key TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_attempt_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, acknowledged_ms INTEGER, last_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mobile_records (path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, phone TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, record_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS tracking_outbox_pending ON tracking_outbox (acknowledged_ms,next_attempt_ms,id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tracking_sync_groups (group_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_served_order INTEGER NOT NULL)
